messages.original_text: How is digital intelligence different from ordinary software automation?

en.body: How is digital intelligence different from ordinary software automation?

zh.body: 数字智能和普通软件自动化有什么区别？

en.body: Ordinary automation follows fixed procedures. Digital intelligence matters when it can transfer across tasks, combine tools, and improve strategies over time.

zh.body: 普通自动化主要执行固定流程。数字智能的关键在于它能跨任务迁移、组合工具，并随着时间改进策略。
